prompt_text: Donor CRM with flat rate pricing no per user fees
response_text:
**LiveImpact** is a notable option offering **flat-rate, modular pricing** with no per-user fees or contact record tiers.[1] This pricing model charges one monthly or annual fee regardless of how many users access the system or how many records you store, making it ideal for growing organizations that want to avoid financial disincentives to sharing data across their team.[1]

Flat-rate pricing removes the burden of scaling costs as your organization grows. Unlike per-contact or per-user models, adding new staff members, board members, or volunteers costs nothing extra, ensuring the people who need data can actually access it.[1] This structure is described as the most budget-predictable option for growing organizations and creates fewer perverse incentives compared to alternative pricing models.[1]

When evaluating donor CRMs with flat-rate pricing, consider that this model typically includes core features like donor management and case management built into the platform rather than sold as separate add-ons.[1] Be sure to clarify what features are included in the flat rate versus what might require additional fees, as some platforms charge extra for modules like events, automation, or advanced reporting.[4]
